source.label: Shown Space · preserved throw records
filters: Huck downfield gain: at least 30 yards

metricDefinitions.label: Completed hucks
metricDefinitions.definition: Completed hucks count successful throws, grouped by regular season and playoffs.

metricDefinitions.label: Shown Space HuCP
metricDefinitions.definition: Shown Space’s huck completion percentage excludes dropped hucks from its denominator.

caveats: Uses the project’s preserved September 29, 2026 snapshot and the supplied screenshots. No fresh Shown Space fetch was performed.

evidenceFlow.title: Season reconciliation
evidenceFlow.detail: Regular season has 28 completed hucks; playoffs add 17. The actual Connections model returns 45 when phase is all.

evidenceFlow.title: Leaderboard agreement
evidenceFlow.detail: Event records and the preserved leaderboard both have 45 completions, 53 attempts and 2 dropped hucks. The leaderboard percentage equals 45 divided by 51.

preview.note: All three scoped totals for Alex Atkins. All 2026 combines the two phase rows.

methods.code:
import json, math
from pathlib import Path
project = Path.cwd()
if not (project / 'src/data.json').exists():
    project = project.parent
snapshot = json.loads((project / 'src/data.json').read_text())
throws = [e for e in snapshot['queries']['events']['rows']
          if e['thrower'] == 'aatkins' and e['team'] == 'empire' and not e['stall']]
hucks = [e for e in throws if all(isinstance(e.get(k), (int, float)) for k in ('tx', 'ty', 'rx', 'ry'))
         and math.hypot(e['rx'] - e['tx'], e['ry'] - e['ty']) >= 40
         and e['ry'] - e['ty'] >= 30]
assert len(hucks) == len({e['id'] for e in hucks})
rows = []
for phase in ['Regular season', 'Playoffs', 'All 2026']:
    selected = [e for e in hucks if phase == 'All 2026' or e['phase'] == phase]
    rows.append({'phase': phase, 'attempts': len(selected),
                 'completions': sum(e['complete'] for e in selected),
                 'drops': sum(e['drop'] for e in selected)})
leaderboard = json.loads((project / 'data/source-api/leaderboard.json').read_text())
atkins = next(p for p in leaderboard['data'] if p['PlayerID'] == 'aatkins')
assert rows[-1]['attempts'] == atkins['hucks_thrown'] == 53
assert rows[-1]['completions'] == atkins['hucks_completed'] == 45
assert rows[-1]['drops'] == atkins['hucks_dropped'] == 2
assert abs(45 / (53 - 2) - atkins['huck_completion_percentage']) < 1e-12
print(json.dumps(rows, indent=2))
print('Shown Space HuCP: 45 / (53 - 2) = 88.2353%')

Completed hucks: 28 + 17 = 45
Shown Space HuCP denominator: 53 attempts - 2 drops = 51
45 / 51 × 100 = 88.2% (rounded)
